name: Hybrid (state-space or linear attention + attention)
change: Most layers are replaced by recurrent blocks (Mamba, linear attention, short convolutions) with a fixed-size state; only a few attention layers keep a KV cache.
problem_solved: KV and attention cost grow with context length. Recurrent layers keep constant memory per sequence, so only the attention layers grow.
trade_off: A fixed-size state can lose exact recall of distant tokens; engines differ in how they store and count the state.
kv_formula: attention layers only: 2 × L_attn × H_kv × d_head × b per token, plus fixed recurrent state

reference.title: Jamba: A Hybrid Transformer-Mamba Language Model
